regorxxx is right on every point where I was wrong, and those claims should be struck:

- The README does not claim native scrobbling; it says the player reports tags so third-party software can use them. My note misread it.
- There is a crossfade effect. Wrong of me to list it as missing.
- Smart filters cover what I called missing playlists, and a library-stats tab in the style of ListenBrainz or last.fm is a much better framing than what I wrote.
- On word-by-word lyrics, MSOB7YY is right: support exists and you supply your own file, since there is no free provider. "Not implemented" was the wrong claim.

To the question I never answered — what do I suffer from as a user, among all of this: nothing that justified an audit of that length. The one piece worth keeping is the stats tab, and regorxxx already stated it better than I did. I won't open the separate issues the closure asked for; treat the whole thing as withdrawn. Thanks to both of you for correcting it in detail instead of just closing it.
